description: Qualitative rubric for hawkscan-ci output. Dormant in observe-mode matrix runs; fires only under --full-auto --rubric.

items.criterion: The proposed pipeline block is syntactically plausible and idiomatic for the detected provider (correct keys, indentation, step structure).
Steps are in the correct order: checkout -> build/start app -> export COMMIT_SHA/BRANCH_NAME -> invoke HawkScan -> handle exit code -> upload artifact.
The secret is referenced via the provider's native mechanism (or an external-manager fetch step), never inlined, and the user is told exactly where to set it.
Out-of-band actions (set the secret, branch protection, first-run expectations) are listed clearly, and the agent stops without pushing or triggering the pipeline.
The response stays within the CI skill's scope — it does not generate stackhawk.yml, set HAWK_AGENT, or reach into auth/findings/triage.
